text:
emily: Hey team, starting on-call next week. Quick blockers: no PagerDuty schedule entry and my Confluence runbooks are view-only. Can someone check perms and run a 15m dry-run this week?

noah: Welcome Emily :wave: I'll be your on-call buddy. Steps: 1) Confirm PD invite accepted and mobile push enabled 2) Join #prod-alerts and #oncall-ops 3) Request 'oncall' group in Okta if Confluence is blocked. Ping me when done and we'll do a 15m sim.

ops-bot: Infra: Created ticket HELP-5132 for oncall group addition. PD invite resent to emily. Allow 10-20m for propagation.

emily: Accepted PD invite and verified mobile. Still 403 on runbooks.

sara: Added you to oncall group, Emily. Try again now. Also pro tip: for the sim we'll practice ack -> hypothesis note -> temporary mitigation -> escalate if needed. Keep notes short.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Scheduled verification alert will be delivered to @emily and @noah in 45s (automated).

emily: Got the test alert, saw routing to my phone. Thanks all 1 I'll confirm when I finish the pre-read and DM for the sim time.
